cover.note: Stephen mid-smile, carrying a basket of bread. Warm morning light. He should look like someone you would want to sit next to.

story.text: Every day he shared food with people who were hungry.

interaction.note: Discovery — nothing here is wrong and nothing is required. Each tap gives a smile and a small thank-you animation.

story.text: Stephen told everyone the good news about Jesus.
When Stephen spoke, his face shone like an angel.
But some people did not want to listen.
They said unkind things that were not true.
Stephen was not afraid. He looked up and saw heaven.
story.note: This is the turning point. Light from above, Stephen calm, the crowd small and out of focus at the edges. We never show the stoning.
Stephen's forgiveness is the heart of this chapter. Give this card the most space.

story.text: Then Stephen went home to be with Jesus.
story.note: Aftermath, not event. Empty warm sky, one basket of bread left on the ground. Nothing frightening on screen.

story.text: His friends were sad. But they remembered how kind he was.
So they kept helping people, just like Stephen did.
story.note: The chapter must not end on grief. This card resolves it — kindness continues.

activity.hint: Stephen was helping people at the very beginning.

quiz.hint: It was something you can eat.
He was thinking about the people who were unkind.

verse.text: Be kind to one another, forgiving one another.

celebration.message: You learned how Stephen stayed kind, even when it was hard.
